definitions.explanation: Used to indicate a numbered item in a series, such as train names, magazine issues, or room numbers.
The suffix used in naming vessels, trains, and other vehicles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧のぞみ{3号|さんごう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: To ride the Nozomi No. 3 Shinkansen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦{号|ごう}→号：13040_gou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought this month's issue of the magazine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧{5号|ごごう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っています→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I'm waiting in meeting room No. 5.

examples.japanese: タイタニック⟦{号|ごう}→号：13040_gou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The Titanic is a famous ship.

examples.japanese: アポロ{11号|じゅういちごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}した→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧。

⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{探査機|たんさき}→探査機：25715_tansaki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「はやぶさ{2号|にごう}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{名付|なづ}けられ→名付ける：11998_nazukeru⟧、⟦{小惑星|しょうわくせい}→小惑星：05244_shouwakusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}して→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧⟦{飛|と}び{立|た}った→飛び立つ：19322_tobitatsu⟧。
examples.english: The probe was named Hayabusa 2 and launched toward an asteroid.

notes:
〜⟦{号|ごう}→号：13040_gou⟧ is a suffix used to assign a number to items in a named series. Unlike 〜⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧, which numbers items in ordered sequences, ⟦{号|ごう}→号：13040_gou⟧ is used for named vehicles, publications, and designated spaces.

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- {1号|いちごう}, {2号|にごう}, {3号|さんごう}...
- ⟦{何|なん}→何：03100_nan⟧⟦{号|ごう}→号：13040_gou⟧: what number?

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- Trains/buses: のぞみ{1号|いちごう} (Nozomi No. 1)
- Magazine issues: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦{号|ごう}→号：13040_gou⟧ / 5⟦{月|がつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧⟦{号|ごう}→号：13040_gou⟧ (May issue)
- Room numbers: 3{号|ごう}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (Room No. 3)
- Ships: タイタニック⟦{号|ごう}→号：13040_gou⟧ (the Titanic)
- Spacecraft: アポロ{11号|じゅういちごう} (Apollo 11)
- Typhoons: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧{10号|じゅうごう} (Typhoon No. 10)

CONTRAST WITH 〜⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧:
⟦{号|ごう}→号：13040_gou⟧ labels items in a named series (trains, issues, ships), while ⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧ numbers items in ordered sequences (1⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧, 2⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧). For example, a train might be のぞみ{3号|さんごう}, but a ticket window would be 3⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧.
